statement: For a fixed dataset, held-out family, rejector, model/candidate configuration, validation information condition and prepared partition, assess whether validation feasibility of that rejector changes as the allowed overall validation rejection budget changes.
aggregation_denominator: six historically count-support-eligible LOAO holdouts per dataset
selection_rule: Use the historically recorded validation-feasible holdout set at each budget; do not infer test-time cost control or recover unrecorded thresholds.
historical_categorical_uncertainty: none; historical categories are exactly transcribed, but statistical/retraining uncertainty and inferential replication are not established

historical_restrictions.CICIDS2017: original recovered construction: shared source days across splits and nonzero exact processed feature-hash overlap
historical_restrictions.CICIoT2023: source/label/proxy/group audit under current five-dataset instrument not yet completed

notes: This is an independently versioned candidate C06 contract. It does not set claim_registry.json to frozen.
The released table contains aggregate validation-feasibility coverage and feasible-family membership, not per-seed predictions, exact selection trajectories or paired evaluation row identifiers.
An unverified eligibility gate stays not_assessed; a descriptive transition is not an admitted categorical stability claim.
